Name: Roche
Description:
Roche is a global pioneer in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics focused on advancing science to improve people’s lives. The combined strengths of pharmaceuticals and diagnostics under one roof have made Roche the leader in personalised healthcare – a strategy that aims to fit the right treatment to each patient in the best way possible.

Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in in vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management.

Founded in 1896, Roche continues to search for better ways to prevent, diagnose and treat diseases and make a sustainable contribution to society. The company also aims to improve patient access to medical innovations by working with all relevant stakeholders. Thirty medicines developed by Roche are included in the World Health Organization Model Lists of Essential Medicines, among them life-saving antibiotics, antimalarials and cancer medicines. Roche has been recognised as the Group Leader in sustainability within the Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology & Life Sciences Industry ten years in a row by the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices (DJSI).

For more information, please visit https://careers.roche.com

Name: Kinarus Therapeutics
Description:
Kinarus Therapeutics (SIX:KNRS) is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company focused on bringing novel, patient-focused treatments for viral, respiratory, and ophthalmic diseases.

Kinarus was incorporated in Basel, Switzerland in 2017.  Our lead drug candidate is an oral combination of a clinical-stage P38 mitogen activated protein kinase (p38 MAPK) inhibitor, in-licensed from Roche, and a second drug, together enabling an oral, long-term effective treatment.

Kinarus has launched a large Phase 2 clinical trial in hospitalized Covid-19 patients with the aim to reduce mortality and duration of hospital stay. The mechanism of action of our candidate is three-fold; reducing viral replication, inflammation, and organ damage.  The trial is actively enrolling patients.

Kinarus has also obtained regulatory approval for a one-year Phase 2 clinical trial in patients diagnosed with wet Age-Related Macular Degeneration. Injectable agents targeting vascular endothelial growth factor are the only approved therapies.  Despite the availability of these drugs, real-world data shows significant under-treatment leading to progressive loss of vision and blindness.  Kinarus's drug candidate, administered on top of anti-VEGF agents, has the potential to reduce injection frequency, providing additional therapeutic benefit and relieving the high burden to patients and their caregivers.

Most repurposing is serendipitous: one drug, one indication at a time. And while AI can now propose candidates at scale, most fail wet-lab validation — the bottleneck has shifted from generating ideas to proving them. Our platform closes that gap, combining physics-aware machine learning, 3D molecular modeling and multi-omics analysis to systematically screen and prioritise new therapeutic uses, then de-risk them through in silico clinical trials and, where needed, targeted biological validation. The result is a scalable engine that turns shelved and overlooked compounds into de-risked assets ready for partners to take forward — shortening development timelines and improving the odds of reaching patients.

Name: NanThermix SA
Description:
NanThermix SA is a pioneer in nanoscale temperature control within living cells for applications across life sciences, from academic research to biomedical fields, including IVD diagnostics, IVF, and drug discovery. We are always open to synergies with investors, strategic partners, and R&D collaborators.

Accessing temperature control at the nanoscale represents a significant milestone in cellular biology, enabling breakthroughs in fundamental research and advancements in biomedical applications.

Temperature is a crucial factor in biological processes, serving as a key indicator of organism health and disease response. Cells, the basic unit of the human body, react to biochemical reactions through temperature changes. Each cell operates as a sophisticated biocomputer, in its simplest form managing over 2000 biochemical reactions instantly, all of which involve heat production or consumption.

Understanding cellular behavior is essential for understanding the human body at the nanoscale. Cellular studies are vital for developing cutting-edge drugs and treatments for various diseases.

Currently, no reliable methods exist to control heat and temperature within living cells, which can accurately reflect the dynamics and intensity of various metabolic, electrophysiological, and morphological processes in both healthy and pathological states.

Our technology addresses this critical gap. 
Contact us to learn more or discuss synergies, we would like to hear from you.

Our story

Founded in the late 1980s by a group of immunologists, our main area of activity is the development, production, and commercialization of antibodies. Our know-how and products

In the past, we have adapted the production of our monoclonal antibodies to culture media free of fetal calf serum. This not only represents an important ethical contribution to sustainability and animal welfare, but the use of FCS-free culture media also offers scientific advantages, such as increased experimental reproducibility, elimination of the risk of contamination by animal viruses and bacteria, and thus more consistent performance.

Name: Zurich Kidney Transplant Cohort
Description:
The Zurich Kidney Transplant Cohort at University Hospital Zurich was established as a research group through our participation in the development studies of the Molecular Microscope Diagnostic System (MMDx).

In 2018, we began collecting kidney allograft biopsy samples in RNAlater, laying the foundation for transcriptome-based diagnostics.

By 2021, we had fully integrated the MMDx platform into clinical routine. This allowed us to move beyond traditional histology by incorporating gene expression profiling into kidney allograft assessment.

Our multidisciplinary team meets weekly to conduct integrative biopsy reviews, combining histological and molecular findings. These meetings ensure consistent, nuanced interpretation of allograft pathology and support better clinical decision-making.

With over 500+ transplant kidney biopsies, we now represent one of the largest independent cohorts worldwide utilizing the MMDx technology. Our cohort has become a strong platform for further research, focusing on validation, correlation and outcome studies.

In 2024, we established our first international collaboration with IKEM Prague, and look forward to expanding these efforts.

Name: Coretag
Description:
People want to enjoy a longer life, and in good health. Celebrating the big and small moments – with family and friends – even when they become a patient. That’s why Coretag set itself goals to improve the diagnosis, monitoring and treatment of cancer. So that people can live longer and treatment times for cancer become shorter.

Coretag focuses on the development of cancer imaging and targeted radiotherapy, based on its proprietary Necrosis Targeting Platform Technology (NTPT). Coretag has developed a portfolio of products that address high unmet needs in oncology. Coretag is preparing to be listed on the Nasdaq stock exchange in 2022.

The NTPT was developed as a result of the discovery of a group of cyanine dyes which have selective targeting properties to intracellular proteins. These proteins become available for binding only when the cell membrane lost its integrity, which occurs once a cell has become necrotic. Necrosis appears in pathological conditions like a stroke, myocardial infarction, and osteoarthritis. Necrosis also appears in aggressively growing tumors, where cancer cells die due to the lack of oxygen, caused by a poor blood perfusion in the solid tumor or metastases.

Coretag defined a pipeline for the development of cancer imaging and targeted radiotherapy, which is executed in close partnership with Prinicipal Investigators and medical hospitals. To further fulfil our ambitions, we are currently forming partnerships with oncologists, radiologists and nuclear specialists in the EU and USA.

Name: Lung Precision Medicine (LPM) DBMR Bern
Description:
The Lung Precision Medicine (LPM) research program is an interdisciplinary initiative that brings together clinicians, biologists, physicists, and engineers from the University of Bern and the University Hospital of Bern. Our mission is to address unmet clinical needs, focusing on acute and chronic lung diseases, lung regeneration, and connective tissue disorders.

We strive to improve existing methods and develop innovative approaches to studying the respiratory system in the laboratory. Our techniques include lung-on-chip models, 3D cell cultures, organoids, and precision-cut lung slices, utilizing patient-derived cells, including induced pluripotent stem cells, to accurately replicate lung conditions and create personalized disease models.

Our research seeks to understand the underlying causes of various lung diseases, such as asthma, lung fibrosis, COPD/emphysema, primary ciliary dyskinesia, cystic fibrosis, bronchopulmonary dysplasia, lung cancer, autoimmune lung diseases, and allergies. We explore the organ systems, key cellular mechanisms, and external factors like viruses and air pollutants that contribute to these conditions. Employing a multi-omics approach with human biosamples, we integrate imaging technologies and disease modeling in both animal and in vitro settings.

Our ultimate goal is to develop new personalized treatments, including potential direct applications to the lungs. As people age, they are more prone to chronic lung diseases like fibrosis and emphysema due to changes in metabolism, mitochondrial function, DNA damage, inflammation, and other factors that impact cellular and tissue function. We investigate these changes across different patient populations to create tailored treatment strategies.

Our laboratory findings are validated using patient samples and clinical studies to ensure their clinical relevance and effectiveness. Our overarching aim is to promote lung health, facilitate healing, and make breathing easier for patients.

Name: ArtemiX Biotech
Description:
AV Fistula Failure: Are We Too Late, Too Often?

In hemodialysis, arteriovenous (AV) fistulas remain the gold standard for vascular access. And yet, up to 60% fail to mature properly, often long before they can be used.
Why? The causes are well known: early thrombosis, poor vessel remodeling, venous stenosis, and persistent inflammation. But the consequences are still too frequent — delayed dialysis, catheter overuse, repeated interventions, and most importantly, patient risk.

 The real problem isn’t just biological — it’s strategic.
We continue to respond to complications instead of preventing them.
Each AV access failure leads to costly hospitalizations, capital loss of usable vessels, and emotional burden for patients and caregivers.
An average thrombectomy can cost $10,000+, not counting downtime and long-term impact on vascular health.

So why haven’t we changed our approach?

 Because prevention is still a blind spot.
 We lack predictive tools
 We lack validated preventive treatments
 And we lack coordinated care between nephrologists, vascular surgeons, and dialysis teams

Yet the need for a shift is clear.
 A proactive strategy can improve AV fistula maturation, reduce complications, and lighten the load on the healthcare system.
 And now, biotech innovation is rising to meet this challenge — bringing new preventive solutions that target failure before it starts.

This is more than a treatment question — it’s a paradigm shift.

 If you're a nephrologist, vascular surgeon, or dialysis center interested in rethinking vascular access care — let’s connect.
Together, we can move from crisis management to prevention.

#Hemodialysis #VascularAccess #AVFistula #Nephrology #VascularSurgery #DialysisInnovation #CKD #Biotech #PreventiveMedicine #RenalCare

Asceneuron is a privately held company financed by a renowned syndicate of investors consisting of Sofinnova Partners, M Ventures, SR One, Johnson & Johnson Innovation – JJDC, Inc. (JJDC) and Kurma Partners. For more information, please visit www.asceneuron.com.


Further information: www.asceneuron.com

Name: NUCLIDIUM AG
Description:
Nuclidium is setting a new standard in the precision oncology landscape by developing best-in-class copper-based radiopharmaceuticals that enable the highest accuracy and accessibility for targeted cancer treatment and diagnosis.
 
Our flexible CuTraceTM platform combines copper radiometals with a variety of highly specific cancer-targeting molecules to rapidly develop novel therapeutic and diagnostic programs. The resulting product portfolio leverages the unique properties of copper to achieve an improved safety and efficacy profile with advantageous economics for hospitals and patients. Nuclidium’s differentiated “diagnostic to therapeutic” approach de-risks our development pathway. With innovation as our core, we overcome supply limitations in manufacturing and distribution, bringing greater flexibility to medical facilities.
 
We are a diverse and interdisciplinary team focused on changing precision radio-oncology for the better to deliver a true benefit to cancer patients.

Name: PharmaBiome AG
Description:
PharmaBiome is a privately-held spin-off company of ETH Zurich and a pioneer in the production of live biotherapeutic products to address disturbances of the gut microbiome. It has developed the first-in-the-industry, patent-protected technology platform for the production of standardized microbiome-based products. Founded in Zurich in 2015, at the intersection of microbiology, biotechnology, and data science, PharmaBiome believes that the future of microbiome-based therapeutics lies in developing the biotechnology needed to produce a solution compatible with the safety, efficiency, and trial requirements of any human medicine. This holds the promise of becoming a first step into the creation of personalized treatments for patients with chronic inflammatory diseases, immune conditions, and special nutritional needs.

PharmaBiome has invested years in developing a biology-based analysis tool that allows for the identification and selection of the metabolic functions needed to restore the gut microbiome to a balanced state. The resulting formulation compounds the over 500 different strains that every person hosts to a minimal consortium of bacteria representing a healthy microbiome. The co-culture of this bacterial mix transforms it into a live biotherapeutic product whose active principle is based on the composition, function, and interactions between the microorganisms. The flexibility and speed of this process are a unique advantage to bring to life effective treatment options.  Over the years, it has been recognized with several start-up awards such as Venture Kick, the ETH Spark Award, and the BaseLaunch Accelerator.

Name: mimiX Biotherapeutics
Description:
MimiX biotherapeutics introduces Sound Induced Morphogenesis. We extend the boundaries of biofabrication, making bioengineered, artificial human organs and tissues a future reality. 
Sound Induced Morphogenesis (SIM) is a revolutionary approach in biofabrication. It mirrors nature’s design, to aggregate and pattern biologicals by tuning sound profiles under contactless, fast and delicate culture conditions resulting in a morphologically induced tissue generation. 
We introduce cymatiX, a unique acoustic biofabrication solution that makes the Sound Induced Morphogenesis technology easily accessible to the scientific and clinical community
Visit www.mimixbio.com to learn more. mimiX biotherapeutics is a Swiss biomedical company.

Name: leadXpro AG
Description:
LeadXpro was founded in 2015 as a spin-out from the Paul Scherrer Institute (ETH) and is located between Zurich and Basel. 

The company aims to revolutionize the way drugs are being discovered for membrane proteins (e.g., GPCRs, ion channels, enzymes, transporters). These protein targets constitute more than half of the current drug targets but have not yet been fully amenable to structure-based drug design due to the considerable challenges in solving their atomic structures. 
To achieve our goal, we combine state-of-the-art methods for membrane protein science together with pioneering technologies in structural biology (Cryo-EM, XFEL).

Our business model includes working in collaboration with Pharma/Biotech clients on their protein target of interest allowing them to keep their target exclusivity and all IP rights. We provide specialized expertise in areas such as construct design, protein generation, biophysical characterization of ligand interaction, crystallization, X-ray crystallography, electron microscopy and data analysis with computational methods. We also provide a lead discovery and optimization platform with the goal to deliver novel leads for challenging membrane protein targets. 
Find out more at www.leadxpro.com

Name: SEED Biosciences
Description:
We are SEED Biosciences, a spinoff from the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology (EPFL).

We make DispenCell. One click, one cell.

DISPENCELL is an automated laboratory instrument designed for fast, easy, and gentle single cell isolation.

DISPENCELL is a pipetting robot designed to be compact, gentle, and intuitive, yet compliant with the most stringent regulatory standards. Designed by scientists for scientists, DISPENCELL has been thought to quickly integrate your lab routine in a plug-and-play approach. Flexible and effortless, DISPENCELL operates equally under sterile conditions in a culture hood, or on a simple benchtop. Its unique technology guarantees gentle dispensing, thus better cell viability and cloning efficiency. A single cell analysis software tool provides immediate and traceable proof of clonality report. 

DISPENCELL is an enabler for personalized medicine allowing scientists to isolate single cells reliably and cost-effectively by reducing lab time and validation time.

Name: ValleyDAO
Description:
Welcome to ValleyDAO, a pioneering community dedicated to addressing critical climate and food challenges through the funding of academic research in the field of biotech and industrial biotechnology. Our mission is to accelerate innovation in tackling climate change, a problem we recognize as a pressing reality.

Our approach is unique: we believe in the power of collaboration and interdisciplinary efforts in the complex field of synthetic biology. ValleyDAO aims to dissolve academic silos, granting researchers access to an expert community for early-stage research development and funding.

What We Offer:
Research Funding and Market Integration: We offer up to $250,000 in funding, aligning research with business objectives to ensure that each experiment contributes towards viable commercial outcomes.
Intellectual Property Incubation: For those with patents or in the process of securing them, we provide comprehensive support. This includes assistance in tech transfer, C-team formation, business development, and fundraising.
Expert Community Network: Our community, comprised of academics, entrepreneurs, investors, and professionals, offers support in areas of funding and IP development.

Community Co-ownership: Members of ValleyDAO are more than participants; they are co-owners. Through their contributions, they earn shares or digital tokens ($GROW) in the organization, granting them voting rights and a stake in the success of our supported research and spinouts. This ownership model fosters deep engagement and active involvement in our collective mission.

Join us in driving innovation and addressing the global climate challenge. Researchers can apply for funding here: https://www.valleydao.bio/apply-for-funding

And those interested in joining our community can sign up here: https://www.valleydao.bio/community

endogena’s mission is to discover and develop first-in-class endogenous regenerative medicines to repair and regenerate tissues and organs. our approach has the potential for a medical treatment paradigm change to effectively address unmet medical needs associated with ageing and genetic diseases.

recent breakthroughs in stem cell biology together with technological advances for phenotypic, functional screening have unlocked our ability to harness the potential of adult stem- and precursor cells. our novel drug discovery approach is based on the concept of selective activation of endogenous progenitor cells for controlled tissue repair and regeneration by small molecules.

Name: Deep MedChem
Description:
AI-Powered Drug Discovery for Medicinal & Computational Chemists through our flagship CHEESE platform.

What We Offer  
Our flagship CHEESE Molecular Search (Chemical Embeddings Search Engine) transforms virtual high-throughput screening (vHTS). It screens billions of compounds (Enamine REAL, Chemriya or your in-house library) in seconds, leveraging 3D electrostatics and 3D shape similarity to uncover drug-like scaffolds. 
You can try it here: https://cheese-new.deepmedchem.com/
Preprint about the technology: https://chemrxiv.org/engage/chemrxiv/article-details/67250915f9980725cfcd1f6f

CHEESE Modeller is a tool for very fast training and predictions with predictive models for properties of molecules. CHEESE Modeller provides you with a intuitive UI to use existing and to train your own predictive models.

CHEESE Electrostatics takes the speeds up dramatically the estimation of ESP/RESP (electrostatic potential) while keeping the accuracy on-par with DFT methods. The tool is available online and we offer also version with full privacy mode. 
Test ride it here: https://electrostatics.deepmedchem.com/

CHEESE Explorer builds on the extreme speed of our molecular similarity engine that allows for interactive exploration of the vast molecular spaces that have been inaccessible for detailed and interactive visualisation until now. Test ride it here: https://explorer.deepmedchem.com/

All our tools are available on our cloud and on premises (on customers' servers).

Detailed documentation is available: https://cheese-docs.deepmedchem.com/

Watch Our Webinars & Tutorials: Dive into AI-driven drug discovery with our expert-led series at https://www.youtube.com/@deepmedchem

Contact us at info@deepmedchem.com

Description:
At BioReperia, we are transforming how cancer therapies are developed and personalized. Topadur Pharma AG is a Swiss biopharmaceutical scale-up based in Schlieren, Zurich. The company was founded in 2015 by experienced scientists that combine several years of expertise in R&D Pharma. Description:
Merrick Biotech stands at the forefront of biotechnological innovation, rooted in the heart of Switzerland, with a vision deeply invested in the pursuit of extending human life and advancing the field of biological engineering science. As we continue to explore the vast potential of biotechnology, Merrick Biotech is committed to contributing meaningful advancements to the field, with the ultimate goal of creating a future where the human lifespan is significantly extended, and healthspan is improved, allowing individuals to live fuller, healthier lives. Through collaboration, dedication, and a relentless pursuit of excellence, Merrick Biotech is shaping the future of human health and longevity, one discovery at a time.

Name: SFL is now Veristat

Name: CellX Biosolutions
Description:
CellX Biosolutions is an ETH Zurich-born startup, on a mission to redefine how we treat chemical pollutants. While traditional methods of chemical disposal, such as incineration, are costly and not sustainable, our pioneering approach leverages Nature's Master Recyclers, bacteria, to address chemical pollution challenges.

We leverage our patented microtechnology deployable directly in remote environments, to capture unique bacterial consortia with superior degradation capabilities for specific micropollutants, such as microplastics, PFAS, pesticides and pharmaceuticals. These biological solutions are then scaled up as a game-changing cultures of degraders, to be implemented directly in industries' chemical storage reservoirs and wastewater treatment plants.

Our ultimate goal? To revolutionize current practices, steering away from costly incineration methods.

Name: Biofactory Competence Center
Description: The BCC is an innovation, applied research and training center dedicated to biotechnology and bioprocess engineering, supporting industry and academic partners in the development, optimization, and scale-up of biological products. Its core research areas include bioprocess development and precision fermentation, recombinant protein production and purification, and the design of robust upstream and downstream processes including Quality by Design methodology. The center has strong expertise in addressing antimicrobial resistance through innovative biological solutions, including advanced microbial and phage-based approaches. Additional activities cover algae cultivation and bioproduct valorization, as well as the development of biomaterials and medical implants, combining biotechnology with process and materials engineering. Through its applied research, lab and pilot-scale infrastructure, and hands-on training, the Biofactory Competence Center acts as a key interface between research and industrial implementation in sustainable biomanufacturing.

Name: Leman Biotech
Description:
Leman Biotech is a clinical-stage cancer immunotherapy company co-founded by Professor Li Tang of the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne (EPFL) and XtalPi, a leader in AI-driven drug research and development. The company integrates innovative metabolic reprogramming technology with a cutting-edge AI drug discovery platform to develop next-generation cancer immunotherapies.

Leman Biotech's Metabolic Reprogramming Technology (Meta 10) represents an innovative approach to combating T-cell exhaustion. Preclinical studies have demonstrated its ability to activate oxidative phosphorylation metabolism in terminally exhausted T cells, restoring their proliferative potential and cytotoxic activity. Promising results from these studies include effective tumor clearance in various mouse models and the induction of stem-like immune memory cells.

In early 2023, Leman Biotech initiated an investigator-initiated clinical trial (IIT) for metabolically armed CD19 CAR-T therapy (Meta10-19 CAR-T) targeting patients with relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (r/r DLBCL) and acute B-lymphoblastic leukemia (r/r B-ALL). Remarkably, all patients treated with Meta10-19 CAR-T have achieved complete responses at low doses with minimal side effects. These findings highlight the immense clinical potential of Meta 10 technology.

The company is headquartered in Shenzhen, a highly vibrant city with the highest number of start-ups per head of population in China, and established a research center in Lausanne Biopôle.

Name: IABS - International Alliance for Biological Standardization
Description:
The International Alliance for Biological Standardization is an independent, nonprofit scientific organization located in Geneva, Switzerland with about 250 members in over 50 countries. Operational offices are in Lyon, France.
IABS vision: Health Solutions for everyone everywhere. 
IABS missions: 
#1 To bring biologicals stakeholders together
Our strength is to bring together private industry, academia and regulatory agencies to conduct scientific discussions on a global scale.
#2 To facilitate consensus
Our collaborative events, such as conferences and workshops, guide decision-making and accelerate the standardization of biological products.
#3 To share scientific advancements
We contribute to the improvement and innovation of biological products, through our Journal Biologicals and the website .
IABS' role and strength reside in its ability to bring together interested parties for scientific discussions of important unresolved or emerging issues and to assist in developing a consensus with an action plan to achieve regulatory progress. This strategy has led to significant gains in both the human and veterinary fields, and it differentiates lABS conferences from most scientific meetings that focus simply on the exchange of information. Our activities contribute to faster global access to new vaccines for human and animal health. We have worked successfully with, and have supplemented the activities of, WH0, FDA, USDA, NIAID, EMA, and OIE.
For more information, please visit our website at www.iabs.org

•	Epitope mapping (both conformational or linear)
•	Characterizing aggregates from biotherapeutic drugs

Name: Gnubiotics Sciences SA
Description:
THE CHALLENGE: Glycans hide the tumor in disguise. 
 Typical cancer-specific Tumor Glycocodes render the tumor invisible to the immune system, they stay ‘cold’. Intelligently, glycans from that Tumor Glycocode are not present on neighbouring healthy tissue, rendering it a perfect target for eradication & potential use as biomarker for patient selection and treatment response.
 So far, efforts to break that code for therapeutic benefits have been unsuccessful. One reason for this is the dynamic shape & motion of glycans, and the inability to manufacture them ex vivo. 

  THE SOLUTION: Conjugated Glycopeptides.
Gnubiotics’ proprietary technology conjugates O-glycans with short protein parts - peptides - ex vivo to form novel glycopeptides that are druggable targets amenable to mass production.
 Breaking the Tumor Glycocode. Since 2019, multiple preclinical models have demonstrated proof of concept for the lead compound GNU101 to be orally bioavailable, resisting degradation, and surviving enzyme proteolysis. The preclinical body of evidence has demonstrated proof-of-concept that the GENESIS platform based glycopeptides are able to turn 'cold' into 'hot' tumors, breaking through I/O resistance and inducing tumor cell killing.

 THE TEAM: 
We are a highly specialized team of Founders, Scientists and Entrepreneurs pursuing the transition from a large basis of preclinical evidence into IND-readiness and the clinics with First-in-human clinical phase 1 study for colorectal cancer patients in 2024/2025. 

 Curious to learn more? Check out our new website and contacts  https://gnubiotics.com/

Name: EsoCap AG
Description:
The Swiss-based, privately funded EsoCap AG pioneers the first and only system administering drugs for long-lasting local oesophageal therapy, meeting a major unmet medical need. Around 370 million people are affected by oesophageal diseases annually. The oesophagus is challenging as swallowed drugs pass through in seconds, impairing the effectiveness of local treatment.

The lead compound ESO-101 for treating eosinophilic oesophagitis (EoE) is ready to enter Phase IIb/III. ESO-101, a topical steroid for first-line EoE treatment, that has been shown to reduce inflammation due to prolonged, targeted 15-minute mucosal contact.

- The Technology -
EsoCap’s system centers on a capsule with coiled mucoadhesive film adhering to the oesophageal wall, releasing medication over time. MRI studies in healthy volunteers showed the film stays over 15 minutes, confirming effectiveness.

- ESO-101 phase IIb/III ready -
EsoCap successfully completed a double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled Phase II study with ESO-101 in EoE, a chronic inflammatory disease, showing significant peak eosinophil reduction (p=0.0318).

- Market Potential - 
The EoE market is forecast to reach USD 6.7bn in 2034 (USD 5bn in the US). ESO-101 is positioned as the only globally approved chronic first-line EoE treatment administered once daily with ESO-101’s user-friendly system.

- Future Applications -
EsoCap’s platform can deliver various drugs, including small molecules, biologics, and RNA. Future applications may target GERD, Barrett's oesophagus, and oesophageal cancer, addressing major unmet needs.

- Business Strategy - 
ESO-101, designated an Orphan Drug by the FDA for EoE, is backed by robust patents in major markets including the U.S., Europe, Japan, Canada, and Mexico. With a skilled team and infrastructure, EsoCap plans to use Phase II data to partner with a leading biopharma company.

Description:

NucleoCapture blood purification technology is based on biocompatible, highly porous polymer beads conjugated with proprietary human recombinant histone H1.3 protein. Histone H1.3 protein was developed by nature to be the ultimate human DNA binding and compacting protein and is a potent sensor and effector of the ancient innate immune defence system with single digit nanomolar DNA binding constants.

As a result, the single pass of NET and cfDNA-contaminated blood through our NucleoCapture device, results in over 95% removal of NETs.

In contrast to any potential pharmacological intervention targeting NETs, Santersus’ technology allows safe removal of NETs from blood without compromising the defensive function of neutrophils. We aim to disrupt any current model of therapeutic apheresis in multiple areas of critical care. 

We have had phenomenal feedback from our diagnostic capability feasibility study which will lead to further development and market achievement in 2021.

Name: GenoRobotics
Description:
Biodiversity preservation has become a major challenge of the XXIst century. Biodiversity identification and monitoring are the cornerstones for preservation actions. However, the classical conservation and taxonomy approaches no longer fit with the emergency of the situation. In response to these great upheavals and the opportunities given by the latest biotechnology advances conservationists have enlarged their toolbox. The use of DNA has deeply impacted taxonomy over the last decade, evolving from a species detection method to a tool for the identification and discovery of new species. However, the full exploitation of genomic technologies requires high sequencing costs and expensively equipped facilities only available in developed countries. Furthermore, exportation of biological samples between countries has been largely restricted by the NAGOYA protocol in order to protect the access to genetic resources and the sharing of their benefits. This creates an impasse for conservation efforts and scientific research, since both directly work with biological samples to study or reference them. The need for on-site genomic tools has become urgent !

In this way, to fill the gap between new genomic conservation approaches and DNA sequencing technologies, we are developing a miniaturized tool to automatically process botanical samples into the field and accelerate biodiversity identification.

While immunotherapy is dramatically improving survival, yet up to 80% of patients fail to respond.

Entering clinical development toward CE IVDR, NinStem LungTM is designed to complement PD-L1 testing and help clinicians in their decision to treat.
The company targets a market of more than 400,000 tests annually across Europe and the US. 
We predict the right treatment at the right time.

Our approach focuses on engineering regulatory T (Treg) cell engagers (TREX) to precisely and safely activate Treg cells, helping to restore immune balance and prevent harmful self-targeted immune responses.

Name: APRICOT BIO
Description: Apricot BIO is a spatially resolved cellular information company dedicated to the field of functional precision medicine, in which treatment is informed by high-plex image-based profiling of the complex drug responses of individual cells that make up each patient's unique cancer. We offer a full suite of profiling products that extract a large amount of spatially resolved information, from molecule to phenotype, to identify how each cell in a tumor responds to a series of drugs. The data accumulated on Apricot's cellular drug response information platform offer improved treatment decisions of patients and prioritization of drug candidates. This empowers clinicians, academic researchers and drug developers to advance the post-genomics era of predictive medicine and drug design.

Name: Torqur AG
Description: Our key product is bimiralisib (PQR309), a dual pan-PI3K and mTOR inhibitor. Such simultaneous inhibition of the ATP site of all class-I PI3K isoforms and mTORC1 and mTORC2 is Torqur’s preferred strategy to reduce tumor growth and slows down cancer cell metastasis. Furthermore, blocking the PI3K/mTOR cascade on both levels minimizes the possibility of cancer cells developing drug resistance.  Bimiralisib is a small molecular weight chemical compound that penetrates the blood-brain barrier showing potent anti-proliferative in vitro activity against a series of tumor cell lines and in vivo antitumor efficacy.  Bimiralisib has been investigated in multiple oncology phase 1/2 clinical trials in various indications where different dosing schedules have been explored. Bimiralisib demonstrated early clinical signs of efficacy and good tolerability with the intermittent dosing schedules enabling the opportunity for further development as a monotherapy and/or in combination with other therapies.  Bimiralisib is a small achiral molecule with favorable pharmacokinetic parameters in different preclinical models. Oral administration of Bimiralisib in clinical development showed encouraging activity and acceptable safety profile in advanced solid tumours and R/R lymphoma.  Bimiralisib is a suitable candidate for the treatment of other indications. As a brain penetrant, the drug could allow the treatment of brain tumors, brain metastasis, and different neurological disorders. Its topical application could be applied against certain skin cancers and dermatological conditions.

Name: Covagen AG
Description:
Covagen develops bispecific FynomAbs by fusing its human Fynomer binding proteins to antibodies, resulting in therapeutics with novel modes of action and enhanced efficacy in the treatment of inflammatory diseases and cancer. The ability to fuse Fynomers to multiple sites on an antibody allows Covagen to create FynomAbs with tailored architectures to maximize efficacy.

Their goal is to access novel biology for each product candidate. Covagens lead FynomAb COVA322 is being developed for the treatment of inflammatory diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriatic arthritis.

In October 2012 Covagen entered into a strategic research collaboration and license agreement with Mitsubishi Tanabe / TRL for the development of bispecific FynomAbs against target pairs selected by Mitsubishi Tanabe / TRL.

Covagen was founded in 2007 as a spin-off company from ETH Zurich (Swiss Federal Institute of Technology). A strong syndicate of investors supports Covagens drug development programs including Novartis Venture Fund, Edmond de Rothschild Investment Partners, Gimv, Seroba Kernel Life Sciences, Ventech, Ascent Biomedical Venture Management, MP Healthcare Venture Management, and Baxter Ventures.

Synameta Therapeutics is a Swiss biotech company developing next-generation exosome-based vectors for precise, targeted therapeutic delivery.

 Built on a novel nanomedicine platform, Synameta enables breakthrough medicines to achieve the outcomes they were designed for. We are working on unlocking the full potential of innovative drug candidates by enhancing delivery, reducing risk in clinical development and amplifying therapeutic impact.

Name: Amela Biosciences AG
Description:
Amela Biosciences develops designed, animal-free protein bioinks for reproducible in-vitro biology. Our platform replaces extracted biological matrices with fully defined, engineered protein systems that offer predictable behavior and controlled biological function.

By separating biological cues from bulk material properties, we enable researchers to select bioinks based on defined, application-relevant parameters, rather than adapting experiments to available materials.

The result is a scalable bioink platform that supports reproducibility across experiments, laboratories, and production batches, and integrates seamlessly with existing cell-culture, biofabrication, and 3D printing workflows.

Description: Saiba Animal Health’s mission is to improve the life of pets suffering from diseases such as allergy, inflammation, pain, nervous system diseases and oncology. We believe that the animal life-companions deserve the most recent, safe and effective treatments when they become sick. To this end, we developed a novel and innovative vaccine platform that is based on non-infectious virus-like particles. Our vaccine platform enables the profound success of monoclonal antibodies to be leveraged into beneficial and cost-effective treatments for companion animals in key areas of unmet need in veterinary medicine. In September 2024 Boehringer Ingelheim acquired Saiba Animal Health AG, adding innovative technology platform to its pet therapeutics R&D portfolio.

Name: Association for Biotechnologies in Architecture and Construction
Description:
Association for Biotechnologies in Architecture and Construction (ABAC) is a Switzerland-based non-profit organisation dedicated to advancing the integration of biotechnologies into architecture and construction.

Founded at ETH Zürich, ABAC connects researchers, designers, engineers, and industry actors working with biological processes and living material systems in the built environment. The association aims to strengthen exchange between scientific research, design practice, material development, and construction by creating a shared platform for dialogue, collaboration, and knowledge transfer.

ABAC focuses on building a community around emerging biotechnological approaches to architecture and construction, supporting:
• Exchange between academia, industry, and practice
• Awareness of living and bio-integrated material systems
• Translation of laboratory research into spatial and material applications
• Interdisciplinary collaboration across design and engineering disciplines
• Early-stage development of collaborative initiatives

ABAC welcomes:
• Academic researchers (PhD, Postdoctoral, Faculty)
• Architects and engineers
• Materials scientists
• Synthetic biology researchers
• Fabrication specialists
• Industry partners working with bio-based materials

Members gain access to:
• Thematic working sessions and exchange formats
• Networking opportunities across disciplines and sectors
• Invitations to members-only events and workshops
• Reduced fees for public programs and symposia
• Opportunities to participate in collaborative initiatives within the ABAC network

By fostering connections between stakeholders across research, design, and industry, ABAC contributes to building the conditions for the broader adoption and long-term development of biotechnology in the built environment.

Name: OnconiX AG
Description:
OnconiX is predicting which cancer therapy works, before treatment begins.

Every tumor is different. Every patient is different. Yet cancer therapies are still chosen mainly from histology, genetics, and population statistics: tools that tell oncologists what tends to work across many patients, but not how one specific tumor will actually respond. Too often, the result is trial and error: ineffective treatments, avoidable side effects, rising costs, and time that cancer patients simply do not have.

Treatment decisions should be based on a patient's own tumor, not on averages.

With our functional testing service OncoXpress, we grow living, three-dimensional replicas of a patient's own tumor, known as patient-derived organoids, or patient tumor avatars. We test real cancer drugs directly on them, generating functional drug-response data helping oncologists replace guesswork with evidence.

Built on over a decade of translational research at the University of Bern, our platform is currently being validated across prospective clinical trials with leading hospital partners.

But the real engine is our team. OnconiX brings together experienced entrepreneurs, business experts, and translational scientists, together with leading clinicians and professors in oncology and tumor biology. We are united by one goal: making personalized cancer care accessible to every patient.

Today, OncoXpress is available as a research-use-only service. Our next step is clinical certification, bringing this technology into everyday cancer therapy.

Stay connected and visit onconix.com to follow our journey.

Xenometrix together with its partners (GLP contract research laboratories) offer you a full range of studies and services for all your registration, notification purposes for chemicals, agrochemicals, veterinary medicinal products, biocides, medical devices.

Name: onCyt
Description:
Founded in 2017, onCyt Microbiology AG is a spin-off of Eawag/ETH Zürich. The company emerged from a need to monitor microbes in drinking water around the clock, leading to the creation of the first fully automated online flow cytometer for the industry.

onCyt's team of experts initially served clients in applied research across Europe, North America, and Asia, and soon expanded into different industries - aquaculture, cooling water, pulp&paper and biotechnology.

Name: REM Analytics
Description:
The microbiome is the ecosystem of micro-organisms that live in and around us, mostly in our gut. It plays a major role in human health, and when out of balance causes diseases such as chronic digestive disorders, diabetes, obesity, allergies, auto-immune diseases and much else. 
We have a genotype and a phenotype. What everyone also has is a  "microtype:" The composition of the microbiome. It affects the response to treatments as well as our food and lifestyle.
REM Analytics provides a novel method to profile the microtype in people.  
For companies producing probiotics, prebiotics, functional foods or other microbiome affecting products, we provide the evidence needed to demonstrate the efficacy of your products. 
We have the unique capability to measure the colonization of specific probiotic strain in the microbiome of people. Also, we can measure the effect of these strains on the microtype at large, as well as differences induced by changes in food and lifestyle. Accurate profiling of the microtype has the potential to identify sub-populations that are more likely to be treated by a probiotic. 
In the long run, our objecitve is to allow the development of Evidence-based, personalised microbiome based treatments.

Name: Foundation for Medical Research
Description: The Foundation for Medical Research supports biomedical science and innovation in Geneva by providing an environment that brings together life sciences, clinical research, and entrepreneurship. Positioned between Geneva University Hospitals and the University of Geneva, the Foundation offers dedicated infrastructure and strategic proximity to advance translational research, helping early-stage discoveries develop into meaningful clinical applications and health-focused ventures.

Name: Curio Biotech Ltd
Description: Established in January 2017, Curio Biotech Ltd is a science-based Contract Research Organization (CRO) providing human in vitro research services to its clients in the pharmaceutical, cosmetic and nutraceutical industries. It has provided specialized and customized human in vitro research services to clients across 3 continents. Curio Biotech’s core expertise is in primary human cells and 3D reconstructed tissue culture systems. These cell and tissue models are used for drug screening, toxicity and functional assays with small and large molecules. Our areas of expertise are human dermatology, immuno-oncology, vascular and stem cell biology, metabolism, inflammation and ageing. We have completed at least one or several projects in these areas. Curio Biotech is aligned with the 3R (Replace, Reduce, and Refine) principles and has developed new in vitro models.

Name: LIRM - Lemanic Institute for Regenerative Medicine
Description:
The Lemanic institute for Regenerative Medicine (LIRM), is a non-profit organisation dedicated to advance drug development and biomarker discovery. We carry out research projects and support global education related to aging and chronic diseases.

Our favorite topics are:
- Stem cells
- Neurodegeneration
- Healthy aging
- Immunology 

If you are interested in collaborating, supporting or learning more about our projects, contact us!

Name: hephaistos.bio

Name: Cetacea Clinical
Description:
Advancing Clinical Research to Improve Patient Outcomes

At Cetacea Clinical GmbH, we are committed to cultivating a strong Quality Culture across every aspect of our work. Through continuous monitoring and analysis of both quality and productivity, we implement robust corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to meet the highest standards and exceed stakeholder expectations.

Our mission is to support ethical, efficient, and compliant clinical trial management—enabling progress in medical research and delivering better outcomes for patients.

Respect: We value the contributions and needs of all stakeholders—patients, sites, sponsors, and partners.

With over two decades of experience in clinical trial operations, Cetacea supports biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies in navigating the complexity of clinical development. Whether you need guidance in trial setup, quality management, or regulatory compliance, our team is ready to support your goals.

We welcome new collaborations and are happy to discuss how we can help bring your clinical research forward.

To learn more about our services and expertise, visit the profile of Cornelia Baumgartner, founder and owner of Cetacea Clinical GmbH pr our webpage www.cetacea.ch.

Name: AKYmed
Description:
AKYmed is building the new standard for semen quality and genetic stewardship—across people, production animals, and conservation.

QualiSperm & QualiSperm Cloud: patented CASA tech + secure cloud workflows for fast, reproducible diagnostics—on site or pay-per-analysis.

Name: Torpedo Pharmaceuticals AG
Description:
Torpedo Pharmaceuticals AG is a biotech company based in Basel, Switzerland, with a primary focus on developing the next generation radiopharmaceuticals for cancer treatment.

The company is dedicated to harnessing the potential of the novel therapeutic radionuclide Terbium-161 to provide safe, more effective, and targeted therapies for cancer patients.

Name: Valerius Biopharma AG
Description:
Valerius Biopharma AG is a biopharmaceutical company that has been founded to provide interchangeable treatment options for high-priced biologics, by developing specialty biosimilars including but not limited to orphan drug biosimilars. Our interdisciplinary team of experts combines decades of experience gained in the biotechnology and biosimilar industry. Excellent process science, deep knowledge and understanding of proteins with their underlying complexity, as well as profound clinical and regulatory expertise, are key factors of our success.

The product pipelines comprises four products currently in preclinical development stages and include monoclonal antibodies, enzymes and fusion proteins covering different therapeutic areas such as oncology, inflammation, ophthalmology and respiratory. The development of our future pipeline candidates is planned to commence in 2022.

The company is driven by a team with proven track-records in biopharmaceutical / biosimilar development and finance.

Name: CanVirex
Description:
CURRENTLY NOT HIRING / RECRUITING

CanVirex is a spin-off from the Heidelberg University Hospital, founded in 2017 in Basel, Switzerland. The company develops novel immunotherapeutics for the treatment of cancer and has recently committed to using its unique technology to develop a vaccination for protection against COVID-19.

CanVirex and Heidelberg University Hospital have signed a strategic collaboration agreement for the research and clinical development of measles-vectored therapeutics. The Heidelberg University Hospital offers a unique infrastructure for swift clinical translation of our most promising drug candidates. Dr. Ungerechts and his scientific team at the Heidelberg University Hospital and the German Cancer Research Center provide extensive technology know-how required for safe and successful clinical development.

Name: EVIIVE AG
Description: Revolutionizing healthcare through advanced liquid biopsies: Uncovering novel biomarkers for early diagnosis, personalised treatment selection and continuous monitoring of treatment responses

Name: Chrondel SA

Chrondel is a global site management organization for clinical research industry.

Name: Marker
Description:
Imagine a world where you know yourself better. Where your health is monitored through non-invasive, easy-to-use tools. Where your medical issues are identified earlier, so you can focus on early prevention rather than looking for a cure.

Thanks to remarkable advances in medicine and technology, this world is made more possible every day. Scientists can spot problems earlier than ever as new technologies in the hospital and the home are changing healthcare for the better.

Marker exists at the forefront of this evolution. We turn the latest scientific research into precise, non-invasive diagnostics and therapies that identify previously unseen issues, measure and inform medical decisions and buy time to treat illnesses before the onset of problematic symptoms. 

We are a rapidly growing biotechnology company with a seasoned research team and a diverse private investor base. We have completed clinical trials and have applied for our CE Mark regulatory approvals for our first two products, and are working to develop additional diagnostic and therapeutic tools to help patients live longer, healthier lives.

Name: Ectica Technologies
Description:
Ectica Technologies AG is a Swiss life science company dedicated to advancing technologies for research and drug discovery tailored for pre-clinical contract research organizations (CROs) and biopharma companies. Our core competence lies in developing sophisticated in vitro and ex vivo stromal models that address intricate challenges in oncology, fibrosis, and tissue regeneration. We extend our expertise to contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) seeking tailored hydrogel formulations.

The company’s patented 3DProSeedTM technology combines the biological relevance of hydrogel-based cultures with highest levels of workflow integration levels in drug discovery.

Ectica Technologies manufactures and supplies the 3DProSeed product line for drug discovery and research in oncology, immuno-oncology and neurosciences. It engages in contract development and production of original equipment manufacturer (OEM) solutions, which can be customised in terms of hydrogel chemistry, product format, usage and branding.

Name: Elthera AG
Description: Elthera AG is a Swiss biopharmaceutical start-up company bringing together experienced pharma and biotech executives with cutting-edge academic researchers to develop proprietary, first-in-class oncology drugs using a personalized health care approach.  Elthera AG is developing antibodies against a novel target whose expression is strongly correlated with an aggressive tumor phenotype and poor prognosis in various types of cancer.  By combining targeted therapies with companion diagnostics, Elthera AG is aiming at providing new personalized treatment options for patients with the most aggressive malignancies

Name: Alp Bio
Description: ALP AI is pioneering immunogenicity intelligence for biologics. Our platform combines human tonsil organoids with generative AI to predict and prevent immune responses (ADAs) before clinical trials. We help drug developers de-risk pipelines and launch safer, more effective antibody therapies.

Name: ONEBIO
Description:
At ONEBIO, we are  experts in business development, engineering and consulting to push the boundaries of innovation and excellence across three key domains: Life Sciences, Space and Civil Security.

Guided by a commitment to innovation, we harness cutting-edge technology, empowered by AI, to create solutions that improve lives, explore new frontiers, and protect our world. Additionally, we focus on developing scalable business models that drive sustainable growth and provide lasting value to our stakeholders.

Name: Quant Biomarkers
Description:
Quant Biomarkers is a science- and data-driven diagnostics company focused on next-generation biomarker solutions in Cardio-Kidney-Metabolic (CKM) diseases, enabling earlier detection, better risk prediction, treatment monitoring, and more personalized patient care. 

CKM diseases, like diabetes, hypertension, and chronic kidney disease (CKD), affect >40% of the global population. These diseases frequently interact – when kidney injury is in play, it drives high morbidity, mortality and healthcare costs. Clinicians and Pharma still lack practical early diagnostics to identify, stratify, and manage early kidney injury, as well as to develop and monitor nephroprotective therapies, leaving ~90% kidney injury cases in a blind spot. 

We are developing a groundbreaking urinary biomarker test, RenoRiskTM, that can readily measure early subtle kidney injury 3-6 years before traditional biomarkers, such as reduced eGFR or albuminuria. The test enables a timely window for nephroprotective interventions (like SGLT2i, GLP-1) and can also monitor treatment effect without time lag. It includes a product for automatic laboratory workflows and a product for point-of-care or home use. With proprietary lab data from RenoRiskTM, we are also developing an AI-powered predictive software for more accurate kidney disease risk stratification, monitoring and management.

Name: GAIN4CROPS
Description:
The GAIN4CROPS project, funded by the European Commission, addresses a critical constraint in plant metabolism that reduces the efficiency of CO2 assimilation and, thus, biomass and agricultural productivity.

Our multidisciplinary team uses plant breeding techniques to create new-to-nature metabolic pathways that assimilate more CO2, keeping it available for plant growth and out of the atmosphere. Starting with bacteria, we are validating our methods in more complex model organisms towards sunflowers and similar crops. 

These new crops could be more resilient to climate change and require fewer resources, making agriculture more sustainable.

This project has received funding from the EU’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under the Grant Agreement 862087.

Account managed by INsociety

Name: BIOFLUIDS.com
Description:
BIOFLUIDS.com is a global biospecimen solutions platform providing pharma, biotech, diagnostics, and precision medicine organizations with ethically sourced human biospecimens, comprehensive clinical data, and scalable collection infrastructure.
 
Through a global clinical site network operating under IRB/EC-approved protocols, we deliver ethically collected human biospecimens across diverse cohorts, sample types, and geographies. Our capabilities include prospective custom collections aligned to client-specific criteria, processing, and data requirements; consented, waiver-of-consent, and remnant inventory; and targeted site recruitment and development for hard-to-source cohorts.
 
Built for modern research programs, BIOFLUIDS.com combines compliant operations, global site access, and highly responsive commercial and project execution teams to help life science organizations meet demanding sourcing requirements and move from feasibility through fulfillment with confidence.

Name: 99 Technologies S.A.
Description:
99 Technologies S.A. (99T) is a company based in Lugano (Switzerland) which has developed a truly innovative and highly effective technology, named HyperDRYMist, for environmental disinfection. 

The primary domain of application of the technology is in healthcare for the disinfection of non-invasive medical devices and inanimate surfaces present in hospitals and other medical care facilities. Furthermore, 99T’s systems find further operational applications in recreational facilities, public and private transport, food industry and humanitarian aid. 99T’s mission is to introduce different approach in the use of automated disinfection systems focusing on preventive instead of remedial only interventions in healthcare facilities and moreover.

The company is currently marketing internationally the disinfection systems derived from the 99T’s technology. 
The 99T systems are EC certified and are already being marketed in different countries in Europe, South America and North Africa.

Name: AsedaSciences
Description:
AsedaSciences has developed a breakthrough platform to predict chemical toxicity risk earlier in the R&D process, enabling scientists to design safer, more sustainable chemicals. Our next-generation, cloud-based SaaS platform, 3RnD, integrates machine learning (ML), validated human-cell–based testing, and dynamic data visualization to deliver earlier, more accurate, and more ethical toxicity insights. By incorporating validated New Approach Methods (NAMs) - both proprietary and from key industry partnerships - AsedaSciences supports the global 3Rs initiatives to reduce and refine animal testing across the pharmaceutical, cosmetics, industrial, and agricultural sectors.

Our proprietary models are trained on high-quality datasets generated from standardized cellular responses to both safe and toxic compounds. This unique data foundation enables our ML algorithms to detect subtle, human-relevant biological patterns that traditional animal models miss - allowing earlier, more reliable prediction of human and environmental risk and supporting “fail fast” R&D strategies.

Through 3RnD, scientists and companies gain global access to scalable, human-relevant testing tools, services, and real-time analytics that help accelerate discovery, reduce development costs, and improve safety outcomes.

AsedaSciences is supporting the global transition to predictive, human-centric toxicology - empowering industries to innovate responsibly, sustainably, and with greater protection for both people and the planet

Better skills. Better data. Better science.

Name: K LAB
Description:
K LAB is a pioneering non-profit biotech community lab specializing in mycelium research and development. Our passionate team explores the remarkable capabilities of mycelium and its applications across various industries. Join us on our journey to unlock the full potential of mycelium and innovate for a sustainable future.

At K LAB we focus our research efforts and teaching onto three streams that highlight the diverse potential of mycelium:

Name: Terrificproject
Description: Supported by CBEJ U, the TERRIFIC project aims to reshape the European Circular Bioeconomy through eight innovative bio-based solutions that will transform the food packaging sector. Bringing together 19 top partners from 9 EU countries, with leadership from Novamont, this forward-thinking initiative is set to drive progress in sustainable and functional packaging. Over the next four years, a state-of-the-art biorefinery will be established—the first of its kind—serving as a center for developing versatile bio-based materials. These materials will underpin advanced packaging solutions designed not only to protect and extend food shelf life but also to enhance transportability and support multiple end-of-life options, from composting to recycling, thus offering opportunities for economic growth while ensuring social and environmental sustainability.

Probionova is a startup that, thanks to the constant research on the human microbiome, is able to provide the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies with the latest generation of innovative and high quality probiotics.

Name: Orio Therapeutics
Description: At Orio Therapeutics, our mission is to save lives by making the regenerative medicine dream accessible and a wide-spread reality. We are dedicated to developing novel regenerative drugs with increased efficacy and reduced side-effects, using cutting-edge targeted drug-delivery technologies to create novel therapeutic proteins. Notably, we strive to demonstrate that efficient drug delivery technologies are not confined to the development of complex devices and drug carriers but can be achieved based on clever molecular designs. Description:
Bioma is a Swiss company with more than 30 years of experience, dedicated to research, production and marketing of products that promote bioremediation (sustainable treatment approach minimizing environmental impact). Nature healed by nature. All our solutions are made in Switzerland.

Our Will

Name: EPFL N-Pulse
Description:
EPFL N-Pulse is a project born from an idea to bring together passionate engineers to build open source biomedical solutions answering people’s specific needs.

During the first year, our goal will be to develop an arm prosthesis controlled by an EMG bracelet, along with a software responsible for 3D scanning the residual limb and a mobile application for EMG calibration.

In the following years, we will be welcoming new projects ranging from VR haptic gloves to EEG headsets.

Name: SunRegen Healthcare AG
Description:
SunRegen Healthcare AG is a pioneering biopharmaceutical company based in the Basel Area, Switzerland, focused on developing innovative, neuroprotective, and neurorescuing therapies for ophthalmic and neurodegenerative diseases. Our lead candidate, SBC003, is a synthetic small molecule in late-stage preclinical development for conditions such as retinitis pigmentosa, glaucoma-related optic atrophy, and dry age-related macular degeneration-areas with significant unmet medical needs and limited current treatments.

SBC003 is distinguished by its ability to cross the blood-brain and retinal barriers, oral bioavailability, and favorable safety profile. Preclinical studies have demonstrated both neuroprotective and neurorescuing effects, with evidence of structural and functional rescue in animal models and promising results in compassionate human use. SBC003 is also being evaluated for additional orphan neurological indications.

Our dynamic team brings together passionate experts with proven track records in drug development, clinical research, and commercialization at leading pharmaceutical companies. SunRegen’s Scientific Advisory Board includes renowned neuroscientists and ophthalmology drug development leaders, and we collaborate with top academic and clinical institutions worldwide. Our achievements have been recognized with multiple industry awards and competitive grants, including support from the European Commission and Swiss government innovation agencies.

As we advance toward clinical trials, SunRegen is dedicated to building strategic partnerships and engaging with investors who share our vision of transforming neurodegenerative disease treatment. Join us as we work to rescue and restore vision for patients in need.

Name: Selmod

Selmod invents and develops innovative antibiotics against infections by microorganisms resistant to established therapies.

Selmod is focusing on research and early clinical development of therapies addressing life-threatening diseases.

Name: Laboratory for Movement Biomechanics ETH Zürich

Name: AL-S Pharma
Description:
AL-S Pharma AG is a Swiss-based biopharmaceutical company dedicated to developing AP-101, a potential first-in-class antibody therapy for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

Founded in 2016, AL-S Pharma has advanced AP-101 from discovery into clinical development. AP-101 is designed to target misfolded superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1), a key driver of pathology in both sporadic ALS and genetically determined SOD1-ALS.

With the backing of experienced partners and investors, we are committed to advancing AP-101 with the goal of bringing a meaningful, disease-modifying treatment option to patients living with ALS.

The Company is headquartered in Berlin, Germany with offices in Nyon, Switzerland and Wiesbaden, Germany, and listed on the Frankfurt stock exchange under the symbol ELN.

Name: Bio Clean Carbon
Description:
Bio Clean Carbon is redefining wastewater treatment by turning it into a carbon-capturing and nutrient-recycling process. Using the natural capabilities of cyanobacteria, we operate open pond systems within wastewater facilities to capture CO2 from the air and absorb nitrogen and phosphorus through photosynthesis. This process reduces greenhouse gases while recovering valuable nutrients that would otherwise cause eutrophication.

Our cyanobacteria thrive even in harsh Nordic climates, making the system highly energy-efficient and compatible with existing pond infrastructure. The resulting biomass is converted into biochar through a low-energy pyrolysis process, locking carbon long-term and producing useful byproducts like pyrolysis gas and nutrient-rich biochar. The approach not only cuts emissions and pollution but also creates new revenue streams through CO2, nitrogen, and phosphorus recovery.

The Bio Clean Carbon solution stands out for its scalability, low energy demand, and easy integration with current wastewater facilities, delivering both economic and environmental benefits. Our work supports global sustainability goals (SDGs 6, 12, 13, and 15) and contributes directly to climate change mitigation and pollution reduction.

We’ve completed successful pilot tests with municipal and industrial partners—achieving over 90% phosphate and 99% ammonium capture, mitigating nutrient runoff and eutrophication in aquatic ecosystems, and demonstrating CO2 uptake seven times greater than conventional algae systems. In early 2026, we’ll begin pyrolysis trials with universities and farmers to confirm biochar’s fertilization potential.  

Bio Clean Carbon represents a transformative step toward circular, sustainable wastewater management. Join us in advancing climate protection through innovative, nature-based solutions.

Name: RDP Pharma AG
Description: RDP’s leadership team and board of directors are focused on getting their products into clinical trials and addressing the unmet medical needs of patients. The team is comprised of entrepreneurs, drug development experts, and biotech veterans. Their extensive experience ensures that the right questions are asked, the right experiments conducted, and the right clinical studies implemented.

Name: Hemastatx
Description:
Hemastatx is committed to bringing scientific innovation to patients with severe and underserved bleeding disorders, aiming to become a leader in hematology. Founded in 2025 as a spin-off from KU Leuven, Hemastatx builds on over a decade of pioneering research in hemostasis at the Laboratory for Thrombosis Research, led by Prof. dr. Karen Vanhoorelbeke.

Our first lead program, HMX-001, is a proprietary monoclonal antibody designed to present bleeding in patients with von Willebrand factor (VWF)-related disorders by targeting the underlying biological mechanism. The program is supported by a robust preclinical data package and broad patent protection.

With headquarters in Switzerland and an R&D hub in Belgium, Hemastatx is strategically positioned within two of Europe’s leading biotech ecosystems.

Name: AND Biotech
Description:
AND Biotech is a science-led company developing bioactive technologies that target the core systems of human resilience like energy metabolism, immune regulation, cellular repair, and adaptive signaling.

We take promising compounds and translate them into clinically meaningful interventions.
We develop scalable technologies that address biological decline, starting long before disease.

Name: Jandus Lab
Description:
Defense is a key strategy in many domains: in the jungle, in sport, in war, but also in the human body. In humans a dedicated system, called the immune system, is able to specifically discriminate between potentially harmful and harmless agents, and react accordingly. Increasing evidence shows that cancer cells, despite belonging to the human body, can be recognized and successfully eliminated if our immune system has been optimally trained. Yet, as exemplified by the increasing number of cancer patients worldwide, elimination of tumors is often unsuccessful, due to numerous strategies employed by cancer cells to impair immune cell function. 

Our research focuses on elucidating the characteristics and function of cytokine secreting immune cell populations in cancer patients. We are using a combination of complementary high-throughput innovative technologies to analyse patient samples and define individual cells in the tumor microenvironment. This strategy will allow us to identify potential therapeutic targets, with the eventual aim of restoring immune function and clearing cancer cells. This novel treatment strategy, immunotherapy, is adhering to the proverb which says, the best defense is a good offense.

This page is maintained by members of the Jandus Lab to share our research updates, events, and lab activities. The content reflects the collaborative efforts of the research team.

Name: YEPHZ
Description:
It doesn't appear on any dashboard. It doesn't trigger any audit. It has never been raised in a risk committee.

But right now, the brains making your most consequential decisions are operating on chronically depleted neurological fuel — and the food system, the pharmaceutical industry, and the healthcare system all profit from keeping it that way.

Even your healthiest executives are neurologically deficient. The food supply has been quietly hollowing out for decades — fruits, vegetables, fish, beef — all optimized for shelf life and margin, not for the prefrontal cortex pricing your next risk call. Clinical research confirms 17-19 hours of wakefulness produces impairment equivalent to legal intoxication. No board would knowingly allow an intoxicated executive to sign a capital allocation decision. They are doing it every quarter without visibility.

Deloitte: $20,000 per affected employee annually. Harvard: presenteeism costs 10x absenteeism. Lancet: $16 trillion in lost cognitive productivity by 2030. McKinsey: $12 trillion opportunity from correcting workplace brain health. It never appears on a report.

Your organization has already tried to fix this. Gym memberships — 8% usage. Meditation apps — 15% engagement after month two. Wellness challenges — 20% start, 4% finish. They failed because they ask depleted people to work harder at being less depleted. Biology does not respond to willpower.

Yephz is not a wellness program. It is not a benefit. It is passive biological infrastructure — developed over seven years of clinical research — targeting the exact deficiencies the modern food system creates. Five capsules. Ten seconds. Zero behavior change required.

The organizations that recognize this now will carry a structural advantage that compounds. Those that wait will manage the consequences instead.

Name: chAIron
Description:
We harness real-world data, scientific literature, and omics with AI and human expertise to push the frontiers of life sciences. By innovating in human target validation, we accelerate potential, de-risk drug development, and increase asset value.

Our expertise closes the translational gap between advanced analytics, complex biology, and market dynamics, providing our pharmaceutical and biotechnological partners with a holistic strategic roadmap of their assets and bringing treatments to patients sooner.

Name: Feinwerkoptik Zünd
Description:
Feinwerkoptik Zünd develops imaging and non- imaging photonic systems and produces miniaturized optical components and optoelectromechanical systems.

Our product development services focus on optical and optomechanical design as well as software and electronics for miniaturized photonic systems e.g. cameras with fix and variable focus and illumination systems.
